titel: Why Raking Every Leaf Hurts Hedgehogs
hook:
WHY ARE YOUR
LEAVES A HOME?

beats.say: Why is raking up *every* leaf in autumn... bad news for hedgehogs?
Rudi loves a *tidy* garden. He rakes up every leaf... and a sleepy hedgehog rolls out.
Still too messy, so Rudi *vacuums* the whole lawn. Now the hedgehog has... one leaf left.
Here's the thing: hedgehogs *hibernate*, from about November to March.
And their winter nest is built from *dead leaves*, tucked under hedges and brambles.
In there, they live off their fat. About *thirty percent* of their body weight.
Wake one up, and it burns *energy* it needs to make it to spring.
So that spotless lawn? It's an *eviction* notice.
Just rake your leaves into a *pile* under a hedge... and leave it there till spring.
And if your neighbour still rakes up every single leaf, just ask them...
